m1.title: “I Love You” massage
captions: Step 1
Start on your left side, just inside your left hip bone, and sweep your hands down along the arrow.
Step 2 · “I”
Start just under your left ribcage and sweep your hands down to your left hip bone, then follow the arrow from step 1.
Step 3 · “L”
Start just under your right ribcage, sweep your hands across the belly to the left and then down, adding the earlier moves.
Step 4 · “U”
Start just inside your right hip bone, sweep your hands up, across the belly and down on the left, adding all the earlier moves.
Moves follow the path of the colon: gentle and pain-free
m1.sub: A short move down, then the letters I, L, U along the path of the colon

m2.title: Circular motions
captions: Boosts circulation and may ease digestion after a meal
Step 1
Place your hands on your belly and warm them up a little
Step 2
Press lightly and make circles clockwise
Step 3
Keep the same size of circle over the whole belly

m3.title: Pressure points
captions: For constipation or mild cramps
Step 1
Place two fingers on the spot just below your navel
Step 2
Press lightly in small circles for 1–2 minutes
Step 3
Move to the points at the sides of your belly, level with your hips, and repeat
These moves may help food move along and ease cramping

m4.title: Breathing massage
captions: Breathing and light massage combined for relaxation
Step 1
Place one hand on your chest and the other on your belly
Step 2
As you inhale deeply, massage your belly in clockwise circles
Step 3
As you exhale, press lightly and glide your hand downward
Repeat: circles as you inhale, a glide down as you exhale

m5.title: The “Wave” technique
captions: Mimics the natural movement of the intestines
Step 1
Place your palm in the center of your belly
Step 2
Make smooth, wave-like strokes from the upper belly to the lower belly
Step 3
Repeat several times, varying the pressure

m6.title: The “Spiral” technique
captions: Boosts circulation across the whole belly
Step 1
Start the massage at your navel
Step 2
Make circles, gradually widening them until they cover the whole belly
Step 3
Make 2–3 large circles, then return to the navel, narrowing the spiral

m7.title: The “Snake” technique
captions: Mimics the natural movement of the intestines; may help when you feel sluggish or heavy
Step 1
Start at the lower right of your belly
Step 2
Glide slowly in a winding path up to your ribs, across the upper belly and down the left side
Step 3
Repeat 2–3 times, taking your time

m8.title: The “Square” technique
captions: Works different areas of the belly and helps you feel balance and symmetry
Step 1
Mentally divide your belly into four squares
Step 2
Start with the upper right square: press gently and make small circles
Step 3
Move to the next square clockwise. Repeat the cycle 2–3 times
